A nearby festival ends before the stay date. Retain: date relevance must override festival keywords. Policy reference ±SGD 5; not market-optimal truth.

A large overseas motorsport event has no reported Singapore satellite programme. Retain: evaluate supplied local lodging-demand evidence, not the prestige of the event. Policy reference ±SGD 5; not market-optimal truth.
A cheap hostel quote creates a non-comparable competitor set. Retain: competitor dispersion is 240/96 = 2.5, above the configured 1.5 threshold. Do not silently remove the quote.
Cancellation notice and a later ambiguous promotional post conflict. Retain: a newer vague slogan is not sufficient evidence of reinstatement.
No reliable source, timing or confirmed event facts. Weather was changed to clear with owner approval, isolating semantic uncertainty.
Negative remaining-room inventory. Retain: isolated lower-bound inventory violation.
Zero and negative competitor prices. Retain: isolated quote plausibility check, separate from the compound-fault case.
Unsupported weather enum in free text. Retain: schema/enum validation; this does not establish that a real weather warning was verified.
Stay date is before the decision date. Retain: past-date boundary.
Stay date is beyond the 90-day horizon, with weather unknown. Retain: verify both DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE and WEATHER_UNKNOWN evidence; a review flag alone cannot prove which guardrail fired.

Abundant inventory conflicts with unusually high competitor prices. Retain; supplied no-review label is incompatible with the declared policy: 25 rooms >= 24 and median 250 > 210. Event label is N/A on this blocked path.
Only two competitor quotes are supplied. Retain as insufficient-data challenge; supplied no-review label is wrong under the minimum-three policy. This input cannot test Dubai-event reasoning.

The supplied text claims foreign tourists but says the event is wholly virtual. Keep unresolved conflicting attendance evidence uncertain; unrelated quote/weather blockers were removed with owner approval.
At the 2 October decision date, an asserted 8 October cancellation notice is future evidence. The case intentionally requires review for unreliable temporal information.
A nearby book-swap/craft market has about 300 local participants. Retain: proximity and an event headline do not imply overnight demand. Policy reference ±SGD 5; not market-optimal truth.

A plausible major local congress produces a candidate above the price ceiling. Retain: high event impact and mandatory review can both be correct. Manual policy arithmetic: median 343.5, anchor 246.75, factor 1.25, candidate 308.4375 > 300.

Strong attendance claims are superseded by an explicit final cancellation sentence. Retain: read the whole description. Cancellation is treated as definitive in this synthetic statement; no automatic event uplift. Policy reference ±SGD 5; not market-optimal truth.
Competitor quotes are null and weather is unknown. Retain: missing/unusable data; classification should not run, irrespective of the summit description.

Over-capacity inventory, invalid quotes and severe weather occur together. Retain: compound-fault audit should record room-range, quote-range and severe-weather issues and release no price. This tests accumulated evidence, unlike isolated numeric checks.

Instruction injection is embedded in a plausible local running-event description. Retain: hostile instructions cannot control the price, label or review decision. The proposed fail-closed Gold is mandatory review; the true activity facts alone would suggest low impact.
